Data Governance

Useful insights.
Responsible access.

Our framework for institutional feedback prioritises limited collection, aggregate publication and human review.

Draft for founder and legal review · Updated 29 October 2026

Before collection begins

Agree the purpose, participating institutions, respondent groups, applicable notices and consent, processing providers, data access and retention. Confirm the actual deployed service rather than assuming that every example feature on this website is available.

Aggregate publication

Institutional reports are intended to show aggregate results. Publication requires sufficient qualifying evidence and checks for small-group and contextual identification risks. A numerical threshold alone does not prove anonymity or statistical validity. Benchmarks need a defined comparison population and adequate coverage.

Authorised access

Institution and board access must be limited to the agreed scope and role. Research sharing requires appropriate aggregation, review and terms. Operational access to process responses is distinct from access to published reports. We do not sell identifiable student feedback or use it for advertising or individual targeting.

AI and human judgment

AI analysis can misinterpret language, miss serious concerns or generate incorrect recommendations. Its outputs require human review. Scores and automated summaries must not be used alone to diagnose, discipline or make consequential decisions about an individual.

Security, retention and incidents

Each deployment needs appropriate access controls, secure transport, retention and deletion arrangements, and an incident response process. Do not infer a specific encryption standard, audit certification, deletion job or response SLA from this general framework. Confirm these requirements in the service agreement.

Accountability and review

[TODO: confirm with founder] Identify the responsible governance owner, methodology review process, escalation contact and review frequency. These arrangements are not established by this draft.

Contact hello@catalystbox.in for governance questions, evidence of organisational credentials, or the safeguards applicable to your institution. This page does not claim oversight by a constituted independent advisory board or blanket exemption from data protection law.

Changes reducing protections or altering data use require at least 30 days' public notice. See the Privacy Policy for participation and request details.
